title: A refused Close sends no status webhook
custom_preconds:
BLOCKED ON RELEASE: this test checks the Open API story of Internal Work Orders (SV-11833), which is built after the Open API refactoring and does not ship with the core release. Do not run it now. It can be tested once SV-11833 is released.

Preconditions

  • Use an Open API key for the test organization, the Open API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure the test location has no accounting integration (neither QuickBooks Online nor AccountingHub).
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a webhook subscription for the test organization pointed at a request-catching page the tester can read. Subscribe it to work_order.status_changed.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in status Complete, whose Shop supplies amount is $15.00.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs, tab 1 and tab 2.
custom_steps:
1. In tab 1, open Close Work Order.
  2. In tab 2, change "Shop supplies" to $20.00.
  3. In tab 1, confirm Close Work Order.
  4. Open the request-catching page to read the webhook requests.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 2:

  • The amount is saved.

Step 3:

  • Tab 1 shows "This work order changed. Review and close again."

Step 4:

  • No work_order.status_changed arrived for work order 1.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11833 (Story 11, Open API and webhooks)

  • S3-E5: “If lines, the shop supplies amount or the classification change after the confirmation opens, Close is refused with "This work order changed. Review and close again."”
  • S11-R3: “Webhooks: work_order.status_changed is sent at Close with the status closed and at Reopen with the status completed (today it is sent at completion only, so Close on a work order that is already Complete is a new emission). invoice.created and invoice.paid are never sent for an internal invoice; that part ships with the core release (S3-R4). Proposed for the API owner to confirm: Convert to No Charge, Convert to Billable and Change category on a work order, Mark as No Charge, Change category and Mark as Billable on a line, and a change of the shop supplies amount send work_order.updated (defined in the catalogue today, never emitted) with the work order and its lines in the body; no new event type and no line-level webhook. The API owner also reviews the line fields of S11-R1.”

From: "Internal Work Orders technical implementation plan", 2026-10-28, last updated 2026-11-10 (revision 5, built on PRD v1.0), sources/TECH-PLAN-Internal-Work-Orders-upload-2026-11-12.md, read 12 Nov 2026

  • Tech plan line 504 (TP-034): “A refused or failed Close leaves the work order where it was and sends no webhook.”
